### Jesus Knows His Sheep
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/jesus-knows-his-sheep
Passage: John 10:27
Points:
- Jesus knows each believer individually and intimately, rather than as an anonymous member of a crowd.
- Christ recognizes His own spiritual character reflected in His followers.
- Like an eager husband recognizing his bride, Jesus personalizes His love and affection for His own.
- Being intimately known by the Son of God imparts deep fellowship and the promise of eternal life.

### Follow Christ, Not the Crowd
Author: Jim Burns
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/follow-christ-not-the-crowd-homeword-october-23.html
Passage: John 10:27
Points:
- Human beings are easily swayed by crowd mentality, often following the herd into danger.
- Christians must evaluate whether their daily direction comes from culture or from Christ.
- True discipleship requires intentionally listening for the Good Shepherd's voice and obeying His lead.

### You Can Relax in Your Salvation
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-august-3-2026.html
Passage: John 10:27-28
Points:
- Salvation is an unearned gift grounded entirely in Christ's finished work, not personal performance.
- When believers experience seasons of doubt, God never lets go of His hold on them.
- Christians can rest in peace knowing that nothing can snatch them from the Savior's hand.

### Being assured of Christ's grip on you
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-dec-17-2010-11642806.html
Passage: John 10:27-28
Points:
- Like a mountain guide anchored into ice to protect climbers, Jesus holds believers firmly.
- True sheep of Christ have complete assurance that He guards and preserves them for eternity.
- During seasons of difficulty and trial, believers must rely on the strength of Christ's unbreakable grip.
